messages.en:
{07 15 00}When I see folks jogging on
sandy beaches,{01 00 00 05 00} glistening
with sweat{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 13 00}Man, it takes me back!{01 00 00 0f 00}
I used to bench-press
killer whales, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Kui ma näen inimesi liivasel
rannal sörkimas,{01 00 00 05 00} higist

{07 13 00}Mees, see viib mu tagasi!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Ma surusin kunagi lamades
mõõkvaalasid, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Looking at the ocean makes
me wanna swim to the other
side of the world!
Wait{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} It doesn't do that
{07 0b 00}to you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:

ujuda teisele poole
maailma!
Oota{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Kas sinuga seda
{07 0b 00}ei juhtu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Listen up, {ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Don't you{01 00 00 05 00} DARE go picking
up my shells, a'ight?
{07 06 00}This is how I make ends
meet, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Kuula, {ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Ära{01 00 00 05 00} JULGE minu karpe
korjata, eks?
{07 06 00}Nii ma teenin oma
elatist, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Swimming like sharks are
sniffing you! {01 00 00 05 00}Sprinting like{01 00 00 0a 00}
crabs crave your toenails!
{07 0d 00}To me, the beach is{01 00 00 05 00} the
training room that nature
built, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ujud, nagu haid sind
nuusutaks! {01 00 00 05 00}Sprindid nagu{01 00 00 0a 00}
krabid ihkaks su varbaid!
{07 0d 00}Minu jaoks on rand{01 00 00 05 00} jõu-
saal, mille loodus
ehitas, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Oooog. I was doing laps in
the ocean earlier and I
chugged a bellyful of water!
{07 13 00}Y'know, {01 00 00 05 00}it tasted like really
salty {01 00 00 05 00}{04 13 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
Weird, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ooog. Ma ujusin enne
ookeanis ringe ja neelasin
kõhutäie vett!
{07 13 00}Tead, {01 00 00 05 00}see maitses nagu väga
soolane {01 00 00 05 00}{04 13 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
Imelik, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}I wonder what happened to
that old salt, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 16 00}Seriously, I think he sang
songs to me.{01 00 00 05 00} Weird ones.{01 00 00 05 00}
Man, I miss that!

{07 0b 00}Huvitav, mis sellest vanast
merehundist sai, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 16 00}Tõsiselt, ma arvan, et ta

{07 1b 00}I guess there are some 
waves that can't be ridden,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
